title: How your fridge really works
caption: Your fridge does not create cold, it pumps heat out of the box. Here is the short version of how that works.

lines.text: Your fridge does not make cold. It moves heat out of the box.
A liquid called refrigerant evaporates inside and soaks up warmth from your food.
Then a compressor squeezes it, and the heat escapes through the coils on the back.
That is why the air behind your fridge always feels warm.
